core_obligations: Construct the canonical map from a K-injective representative using g_! f'_* = g_! f'_! = f_! g'_! = f_* g'_! and the map into the K-injective replacement (proof lines 2696-2712).

Prove case (a) from case (b): descending induction on the vanishing bound a with the distinguished triangle H^a(K)[-a] -> K -> tau_{>=a+1}K, trivial vanishing below a, and five lemma applied to the displayed map of long exact sequences (the mechanical diagram check is the author's 'Some details omitted', disclosed in the editorial note); finish torsion sheaves by the n-torsion filtration F = union F[n] and filtered-colimit commutation of g_!, g'_!, R^p f_* , R^p f'_* (proof lines 2786-2830).
